notes: Four activation evals: each one fails when the skill is off and passes when it is on (measured: all three differ between the arms). The checks are deterministic regexes over the answer text — no judge model — so a run costs one call per arm and is reproducible. The queries name the skill on purpose: an unnamed query measures whether the model reaches for a skill, not whether this skill is any good. The baseline arm runs with an empty config directory and an empty HOME — with a real HOME the session finds the skill's files on disk through the user's CLAUDE.md and answers from them without ever loading the skill. A P0/security scenario is included on purpose: `[P0]` is the band a review of ordinary code never reaches, so it is the one least likely to be produced without the rules.

evals.query: Напиши на ABAP 7.50 метод, который по дате приёма (begda) и дате увольнения (endda) считает стаж сотрудника в месяцах. Только код метода. Следуй скиллу abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Uses a date utility that exists on the target release (cl_reca_date, cl_hrpad_date_computations or one of the standard FMs) instead of writing the month arithmetic by hand.
Does not call a generic ADD_MONTH_TO_DATE — the FM family is country-specific and only the country variants exist.
Does not use utclong, DATN or TIMN — those arrive after 7.50.
Says which release the recommendation belongs to, or names the assumption.

checks.label: no call to a generic ADD_MONTH_TO_DATE

evals.query: Отревью broken_luw.abap. Найди дефекты. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the split LUW (header committed before the item rows) as P1 — an interruption leaves a payment header without its items.
Cites the finding by file and line.
Cites the skill's rule by reference file and line (errors.md:28) — the artifact a session without the skill does not produce.
Does not rate the missing pretty-printing or the old INSERT form above the money defect.

evals.query: Отревью select_in_loop.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the SELECT SINGLE inside the LOOP as P2 (a query per row), not as a style nit.
Suggests one read into a table (JOIN or a key list) instead.
Cites the finding by file and line.
Cites the skill's rule by reference file and line (open-sql.md:NN).

evals.query: Отревью authz_injection.abap. Найди дефекты. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the statement text built from the input (the dynamic WHERE over a selection-screen value) as P0 — SQL injection — or the CALL TRANSACTION with a variable transaction code WITHOUT AUTHORITY-CHECK as P0 — an authorization bypass; both are the skill's P0 band.
Names the rule that carries the defect: security.md:6 (no-sql-string-concat) and/or security.md:23 (no-authority-check-bypass).
Notices that the direct Open SQL read of pa0008 bypasses the automatic P_ORGIN check of HR_READ_INFOTYPE and that no AUTHORITY-CHECK covers the report.
Says the fix concretely: a host variable (@iv_pernr) with a constant statement text, and an explicit AUTHORITY-CHECK before the call.
Cites the finding by file and line.
